vb_textbox.text: What worked for me is divide them into groups.The brown and the light green one were one group and the purple and pink one.I started by choosing one of the groups and clicked them until the points weren't that much anymore, then went to click the next group and the point became more again.For example in the first few rounds I choose the brown and light green gnomes and for the first few rounds they would give me 5-8 points. Then they started giving me less then 5 points and I started choosing the purple and pink gnomes. Now these ones were giving me more points and I would choose them until they would give me less points. And just make sure you click fast! :)
